summary_reason: Example 1 and the dialogue suffered from extreme domain hallucination, conflating a routine commercial delivery note (納品書) with corporate governance documents such as board meeting notices and executive proposals.

collocations.reason: Standard business collocation for creating a delivery slip.
Common when submitting delivery slips to clients or accounting departments.
'発送する' strictly applies to cargo, packages, or goods. For documents like delivery slips, '送付する', '発行する', or '同封する' is standard Japanese.
Standard business collocation for receiving and acknowledging a delivery note.

examples.reason: Severe hallucination. A '納品書' (delivery slip) accompanies goods; it has nothing to do with statutory deadlines or proceedings for shareholder meetings and board meetings. This mistakenly reused a template intended for convocation notices (招集通知) or financial statements (計算書類).
examples.suggested_ja: 商品が倉庫に到着した際は、現品と納品書の記載内容を照合した上で、受領印を押印してください。
examples.suggested_vi: Khi hàng hóa đến kho, vui lòng đối chiếu hàng thực tế với nội dung trên phiếu giao hàng trước khi đóng dấu biên nhận.
examples.suggested_en: When goods arrive at the warehouse, please verify the physical items against the delivery slip before stamping for receipt.

examples.reason: Authentic and natural description of internal controls and document retention under corporate accounting practices.

dialogue.reason: Gross mismatch with reality. A delivery slip (納品書) is not prepared for meetings, nor does it require executive pre-approval (役員の事前承認) or literary drafting/polishing (推敲). This is a copy-paste artifact from a board agenda or proposal template.

suggested_turns.speaker: A
suggested_turns.ja: 本日納品された部材ですが、同封されているはずの納品書が見当たりません。
suggested_turns.vi: Về số linh kiện giao hôm nay, tôi không thấy phiếu giao hàng đáng lẽ phải được gửi kèm bên trong.
suggested_turns.en: Regarding the materials delivered today, I can't seem to find the delivery slip that was supposed to be enclosed.

suggested_turns.speaker: B
suggested_turns.ja: 申し訳ありません。仕入先に確認したところ、別途PDFにて送付済みとのことですので、すぐに転送いたします。
suggested_turns.vi: Tôi thành thật xin lỗi. Sau khi kiểm tra với nhà cung cấp, họ báo đã gửi riêng qua file PDF, tôi sẽ chuyển tiếp ngay cho anh.
suggested_turns.en: I apologize. I checked with the supplier and they mentioned it was sent separately as a PDF, so I will forward it to you immediately.

translations.reason: Term-level translations accurately reflect 'phiếu giao hàng' and 'Delivery slip / Delivery note'.
